phase-plan.purpose: Make the KAPLAY build read like the first playable consumer of the content delivery engine instead of an auto-loaded debug surface. The immediate slice is a real start flow: main menu, New Game / Continue, opening beat, then room navigation.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: project-summary documentation, XML task/roadmap sync, KAPLAY boot flow, save-slot handling needed for New Game / Continue, and an intro presentation layer that frames the room-navigation game start. Out of scope: full tile-layout payload authoring, new combat systems, or deeper docs-site/gameplay shell rewrites.

implementation-slices.slice: Document the repo-level product framing so planning reflects that the game is the demo consumer of a schema-first content delivery engine.
Replace auto-boot behavior with a main menu that exposes New Game and Continue explicitly.
On New Game, clear autosave state, start a fresh engine run, and surface the opening beat before entering room navigation.
Verify KAPLAY still builds and typechecks after the boot-flow refactor.

task.description: Add a planning-level project summary and sync ROADMAP / TASK-REGISTRY / STATE with the new start-flow lane.
Refactor `packages/kaplay-demo/src/main.ts` so the game opens on a real menu with explicit New Game and Continue actions rather than silently loading or creating a run.
Add the opening beat and fresh-run reset behavior needed for New Game so the first room entry has narrative framing.
Run KAPLAY typecheck/build verification after the boot-flow changes.
